sources.purpose: Attestation among the country's resident population, not a claim of national linguistic origin; no incidence estimates used as selection weights.
Pinned Latin-script national surname list, source ordering retained after documented de-duplication/exclusions. Redistribution rights not established; data are research-only.

Official 1939 McCune-Reischauer versus 2000 Revised Romanization comparison; source Latin forms preserve historical unmarked MR-influenced and individually observed surname spellings, not a claim of complete RR conformity.

Cross-reference for surname spellings; 71 source-observed Latin variants of identifiable surname groups suppressed (e.g. I/Lee/Yi/Rhee, Pak/Park/Bak, Choe/Choi/Choy); non-Korean-origin resident surnames retained when source-attested.

sources.romanization: Source-recorded MR/RR-influenced Latin surname spellings retained, no invented Hangul-to-Latin outputs. Additional identifiable Romanization equivalents removed by reference alias groups. Foreign-origin surnames included where source attests population.
sources.partial_pool: Only the top 1,090 source entries were accessible, not the underlying 30,165 reported Forebears surname records. Target 3,000 not achieved without unsupported names; do not fill synthetically.
sources.remaining_evidence_caveat: Census-based population/variant and residency provenance require independent audit; production_ready remains false.

sources.research_scope: Manually cross-referenced positive-incidence source-listed surnames, including foreign-origin surnames of residents; retained exactly as published in Latin, no new Hangul transliterations or generated spelling variations.
sources.quality_limitations: Several records have just one reported incidence; individual record-level corroboration and rights of reuse are not independently verified. Known alternate romanizations and names of unclear surname status were conservatively excluded. Research only.

sources.regional_scope: Seoul, South Korea (surname presence in national resident population, not an etymological Korean-origin claim)
sources.source_table: 2014 Forebears Seoul incidence table; researched surname rows in the site's alphabetical low-incidence section, predominantly rank 730 with estimated incidence 1.
sources.source_value_policy: Latin source-published surname strings only; no fabricated strings, no synthesized Hangul readings. Removed repeated case-folded spellings, visually apparent given names and possible Korean romanization aliases. No weight or incidence property added to surname entries.
sources.licensing_and_attestation_caveat: Secondary historical frequency estimates, including single-reported-person entries; human verification of each surname's resident attestation, 2014 source sampling and reuse rights has NOT been completed. Keep production_ready=false.
